description: Always-on regulator-handover module. Bundles role-profile sync ledger, URA gate proofs, RBAC matrix snapshots, drift telemetry samples, and tenant migration ledgers into a single signed deliverable any auditor can pull on demand.

doctrine.principle: Audit Shelf is a built-in handover surface — every tenant is implicitly entitled. Auditors with the 'auditor' role can run on-demand bundle exports without operator intervention.
doctrine.alwaysOnRationale: Regulator handover must never depend on whether the customer purchased a module.

permissions.description: Counter-sign an audit bundle for handover.
